author: piratewithgun
body: I understand that you are only trying to do your job by banning hackers but I honestly have never hacked and although the evidence suggests otherwise, I would really appreciate it if you could approach my appeal with an open mind from my perspective. Even if you have tested the mod and it and it seems like it is accurate, could it still be possible that in the particular circumstances it could have been unreliable for some reason?? I honestly am legit and I ask you to please reconsider because being excluded from Avicus is a big deal for me and I know I have quite a few infractions over the past months but I would never hack. Thank you

replies.author: Ironsoldier2000
replies.body:
Hello,

You have made around 2 appeals in the past week or so. I believe one was denied yesterday; hence, this appeal is being denied. Please wait an upwards of 6 months before appealing again.

Thanks,
Iron, Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
